description: Makes a urlhub set from links: a short link that opens a page with every link's picture, title and description, and its QR code as PNG and SVG files. Good when several links should travel together: sent to someone, opened later on a phone, or printed as one QR code on a poster or a slide (gift ideas, products to compare, a reading list, a trip plan, links for a class). With a title (and a description) it publishes the set as a page with that heading, for a set to send round or print; without one it makes a short link. Both are public to anyone who has the link. The same links always give the same link; to change a set, call make_set again. A short link nobody opens for 90 days goes away, a page after a year; long_link, when the list is short enough, holds every link in the address itself and never goes away.

description.description: A line under the heading (only with a title)

title.description: A heading for the set, e.g. "Gift ideas for Dad under $50": makes a page

urls.description: The links, in the order to show them (1 to 200, http or https)

view.description: table (the default) or tiles with big pictures, for products and looks

name: make_set

count.description: How many links the set has

kind.description: page when a title was given

link.description: The link to give the person

long_link.description: The same links in one address (?urls=) that never goes away, without the title; only when they fit in an address

qr_png.description: The QR code of the link (PNG)

qr_svg.description: The same code as SVG, to print

title: Make a set of links
